dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet Amidst Gray Ash (II)
dialogues.text: Within the colorless realm... It seems the words upon it cannot be read...

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet Amidst Gray Ash (II)
dialogues.text: (A stone tablet eroded by the passage of the long years. The writing is now blurred, the patches that remain now islands of clarity amid a blurry sea...)

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet Amidst Gray Ash (II)
dialogues.text: "...By day, the sages in white engraved golden inscriptions like glowing rings upon the stone dragon."

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet Amidst Gray Ash (II)
dialogues.text: "'You must all pay your respects to this stone dragon, venerating it daily, only then can...'"

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet Amidst Gray Ash (II)
dialogues.text: "Hereafter... The priests so executed their duties, and Cinder City was never again covered by the remaining ash..."
